title: 第19章 惊为神明第20章 考核开始
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
“秦……秦公子。老朽可以看看这些丹药吗？”
段公愚起身，额头上渗着一层细密的汗珠，但他此时已经无暇去擦拭。
“当然可以！”
秦伏天淡淡一笑。
段公愚伸出颤抖的手，将丹药瓶握在手里。
可以肯定的是，段公愚从未有过如此激动地握着一瓶聚灵丹。
他将其中的丹药倒出。
一枚枚丹药如同玉豆一般地落入乳白色的玉盘内……
“四纹、五纹、四纹……六纹，七纹……”
段公愚心里的惊涛骇浪，一波接着一波。
最后，差点直接给秦伏天跪下。
此时在他心里，秦伏天已是和神明无异！
十六枚聚灵丹，三枚三纹，四枚四纹，四枚五纹，四枚六纹，还有一枚竟然是七纹！
看着十六枚聚灵丹上若隐若现的光纹良久，段公愚再次狠狠地咽下一口唾沫。
“哎……”
然而，秦伏天看到这些丹药，却是无奈地摇了摇头。
太久没有炼丹，这手艺有些生疏了啊。
至于为什么没有炼制出八纹宝丹以及九纹圣丹，那是因为现在秦伏天并没有灵火。
没有灵火的炼丹师绝对不可能炼制出九纹圣丹。
其次，便是丹炉的缘故。

这丹炉也太过一般，虽然是灵丹阁最好的丹炉，但依旧难入秦伏天法眼。
看到秦伏天这番不甚满意的表情，段公愚心里更是狠狠抽了一下。
“秦公子！您可愿意拜老朽为师？”
段公愚心里无比激动，朝着秦伏天无比恭敬地说道。
“嗯？”
秦伏天眉头微挑。
“不，不……”段公愚这才意识到自己说错了话，连忙改口道：“秦公子，您可愿意让老朽收你为徒……”
“不对！”
段公愚又是连连摇头，慌忙解释：“秦公子可愿意……收老朽为弟子？”
秦伏天闻言，却是一笑：“你觉得，你有资格做我弟子吗？”
段公愚心中一颤，猛然惊醒。
是啊，自己又有什么资格做秦公子的弟子？
以秦公子这般恐怖的炼丹造诣，想要成为他弟子的人，恐怕不计其数。
“秦公子，是我唐突了！”段公愚连忙说道，他不想惹来秦伏天的不悦。
只要和秦伏天关系交好，或者说，让秦伏天不至于讨厌他，那么以后多多少少还有机会学到些东西。
“刚才我炼丹的过程，你都看到了。至于能学多少东西，那就是你的本事了！”秦伏天又道。
“是，是！”
段公愚连连点头，脑海之中回想起刚才秦伏天炼制丹药的画面，如获至宝。
“不过眼下，你还是不要尝试炼丹，在彻底治愈走火入魔的顽症之前，你最好不要动用体内的真元。”秦伏天又道。
“是！”段公愚恭敬地点头。

现在他心里很是难耐，很想要消化刚才从秦伏天那里学到的一些东西。
也不知自己是学会了，还是学废了。
“少爷，喝茶。”
而这时，秦青瑶给秦伏天端来了一杯茶。
content_en:
"Qin... Mr. Qin. Can I take a look at these pills?"
Duan Gongyu stood up, with a layer of fine beads of sweat on his forehead, but he had no time to wipe it away at this time.
"Of course!"
Qin Futian smiled faintly.
Duan Gongyu stretched out his trembling hand and held the elixir bottle in his hand.
What is certain is that Duan Gongyu has never been so excited as he held a bottle of Spirit Gathering Pill.
He poured out the elixir.
Pills fell into the milky white jade plate like jade beans...
"Four lines, five lines, four lines...six lines, seven lines..."
Duan Gongyu's heart was filled with turmoil, one after another.
In the end, he almost knelt down to Qin Futian.
At this time, in his heart, Qin Futian was no different from a god!
Sixteen Spirit Gathering Pills, three with three lines, four with four lines, four with five lines, four with six lines, and one with seven lines!
After looking at the looming light patterns on the sixteen spirit gathering pills for a long time, Duan Gongyu swallowed hard again.
"Hey..."
However, when Qin Futian saw these pills, he shook his head helplessly.
It’s been too long since I’ve made alchemy, so I’m a bit rusty at this skill.
As for why the Eight-Line Treasure Pill and the Nine-Line Holy Pill were not refined, it was because Qin Futian did not have spiritual fire.
It is absolutely impossible for an alchemist without spiritual fire to refine the Nine Marks Holy Pill.
Secondly, it is because of the alchemy furnace.
This alchemy furnace is too ordinary. Although it is the best alchemy furnace in Lingdan Pavilion, it is still difficult to catch Qin Futian's eyes.
Seeing Qin Futian's dissatisfied expression, Duan Gongyu's heart twitched even more.
"Master Qin! Are you willing to become my master?"
Duan Gongyu was extremely excited and said to Qin Futian with great respect.
"Huh?"
Qin Futian raised his eyebrows slightly.
"No, no..." Duan Gongyu realized that he had said the wrong thing and quickly changed his words: "Master Qin, are you willing to let me accept you as my disciple..."
"No!"
Duan Gongyu shook his head again and again, and hurriedly explained: "Master Qin, are you willing...to accept me as your disciple?"
When Qin Futian heard this, he smiled: "Do you think you are qualified to be my disciple?"
Duan Gongyu's heart trembled and he suddenly woke up.
Yes, what qualifications do I have to be Master Qin’s disciple?
With Master Qin's terrifying alchemy attainments, there are probably countless people who want to become his disciples.
"Mr. Qin, it was me who was abrupt!" Duan Gongyu said quickly. He didn't want to make Qin Futian unhappy.
As long as you have a good relationship with Qin Futian, or in other words, if Qin Futian doesn't hate him, then you will have a chance to learn something in the future.
"You saw the process of my alchemy refining just now. As for how much you can learn, that's up to you!" Qin Futian said again.
"Yes, yes!"
Duan Gongyu nodded repeatedly, recalling the scene of Qin Futian refining the elixir just now in his mind, as if he had found a treasure.
"But right now, you should not try to make elixirs. You'd better not use the true energy in your body until you are completely cured of your obsession." Qin Futian said again.
"Yes!" Duan Gongyu nodded respectfully.
Now he was very impatient and wanted to digest some of the things he had just learned from Qin Futian.
I don’t know if I have learned it or failed to learn it.
"Master, drink tea."
At this time, Qin Qingyao brought Qin Futian a cup of tea.
